products.name: Anyword
products.note: Predictive performance AI copy; marketing optimization; data-driven; performance claims

profile_text.body:
Anyword is a software company that offers an AI content platform aimed at go-to-market teams focused on marketing performance and brand consistency. The company describes its platform as LLM-agnostic, meaning it is designed to work alongside any AI model or application, and it adds what the company calls A/B-tested data and brand context at each stage of the content generation process. The company claims its platform produces a 76% improvement in AI content performance and a 30% lift in business outcomes compared to baseline AI models.

The platform's headline capability is performance prediction, which the company says can accurately identify which of two content variations will perform better given a specific audience, business goal, and channel, citing 82% accuracy for its own system versus 52% for generic models such as GPT-5. Additional features include a Content Intelligence tool that compares published content against Anyword's industry-specific A/B test data to surface optimization opportunities, persona creation, and APIs for integrating performance prediction and retrieval-augmented generation into external applications. The company states that user data is never used to train third-party models and that its generation engine maintains full data isolation.

On the security and compliance side, Anyword states adherence to SOC 2, ISO, GDPR, and HIPAA standards, and supports SSO, multi-factor authentication, and role-based permissions. The site also notes 99.9% uptime with global availability and failover systems. The held facts record one tracked product under the writing and editing category, consistent with the platform described on the company's site, and no litigation or regulatory filings are noted.
